lore.text: Leonard Snart and his sister Lisa were born into a poor family. They lost their mother when they were young. Their father responded to his wife's death by turning to alcohol and becoming abusive. The only respite Leonard got was when his grandfather brought the kids to his workplace, an ice factory. Leonard came to associate cold with sanctuary. As an adult, he stole cyclotron technology and used it to develop a cold gun that could produce a variety of effects using intense cold. Using it to steal, he battled The Flash and was defeated. He began to team up with other enemies of The Flash, a loose-knit group who called themselves the Rogues. Leonard's sister Lisa, a talented ice skater, joined her brother in his criminal acts as the Golden Glider.

After The Flash (Barry Allen) was seemingly killed in the Crisis on Infinite Earths, Captain Cold managed to get released from prison thanks to a stint with the Suicide Squad. He subsequently had a less confrontational relationship with Barry's successor as The Flash, Wally West. Wally even attended the prison release party thrown by the Rogues, and, though it ended in a drunken brawl among the Rogues, Snart, and West, they bonded over shared feelings of inadequacy. Later, Leonard and Lisa Snart tried to go straight, hiring themselves out for specialized missions, but before long, they found working for a living frustrating and returned to a life of crime.

The Rogues were given a strange mission by Abra Kadabra, a criminal from the future. Told to strike five locations across the country, they found themselves consumed by mystic green flames. It turned out the five locations were important mystically as they were five points of a pentagram, and the flames were hellfire from the demon Neron, who claimed the Rogues' souls and sent their soulless bodies to wreak havoc on Earth. The Flash (Wally West) and Linda Park made a deal with Neron to give the Rogues their souls back in exchange for Wally and Linda sacrificing their love for each other. Later, Captain Cold helped The Flash fight Tar Pit to repay him.

Inertia, an evil clone of Barry Allen's grandson Bart, also known as Impulse, recruited Captain Cold and the Rogues to help with a device he claimed would stop time, allowing them to steal with impunity. But when the then-current Flash—who, unbeknownst to the Rogues, was Bart Allen—arrived to stop them, it turned out the machine was designed to steal his Speed Force and give it to Inertia. Bart was left powerless, but it was still possible to return his powers to him. To prevent this, Captain Cold and the Rogues attacked the powerless Flash, killing him. (However, Bart was pulled into the Speed Force upon his death and later was resurrected by the Legion of Super-Heroes.) Now marked as hero killers, Captain Cold and the Rogues were hunted relentlessly, abandoned by Inertia and other villains.

Captain Cold and the Rogues spent a long time on the run. They regretted killing the latest Flash when they learned how young he was. During the Final Crisis, Libra and his Secret Society of Super-Villains tried to recruit the Rogues as experts in fighting Speedsters, because Barry Allen had returned. Captain Cold refused, angry that the villains had abandoned them until they needed them. The Society had a team of villains called the New Rogues kidnap Captain Cold's father as leverage, but Captain Cold was unmoved. He and the Rogues killed the New Rogues and his father all at once. Then, they killed Inertia, leaving his body on the steps of the Keystone City Police Department with a note that said "Tell The Flash we're even".

Leonard's sister Lisa, also known as Golden Glider, had been giving her boyfriends technology based on her brother's, so they could team with her as the criminal Chillblaine. They proved less effective than Leonard, inevitably getting arrested while Lisa escaped. The fourth Chillblaine, however, was a ruthless and sadistic man who murdered Lisa. Captain Cold found and killed him in revenge. When the Black Lantern Corps reanimated dead heroes and villains, Lisa was among them and attacked her brother, berating him for failing her. Captain Cold was able to control his emotions and freeze her in a block of ice. Following the Blackest Night incident, Lisa was one of the Black Lanterns who was returned to life by the White Lanterns, and she has since returned to her brother and the Rogues.

guide.overview: Captain Cold is a Supporter with **freeze-based crowd control**. He can **freeze enemies within range** and mark one target to **increase their Physical DMG taken**.

legacyPieces.name: Starheart Staff
legacyPieces.reason: Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Captain Cold casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate makes enemies take more physical damage, this staff helps physical squads capitalize on this window.

legacyPieces.name: Energy Mace
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Attack and Effect Accuracy. Captain Cold needs to reliably freeze enemies, so the Effect Accuracy bonus is key for his crowd control to land.

legacyPieces.name: Flash-Bulb Kite
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Energy gain. Captain Cold's Ultimate is the key to boosting the squad's physical damage, so faster Energy recovery lets him create more opportunities for the squad to strike.
